user.title: CellarTracker
user.description: Sign in with your CellarTracker account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate CellarTracker
reauth_confirm.description: CellarTracker rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach CellarTracker. Check your network and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This CellarTracker account is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: CellarTracker is already configured. Only one account is supported per Home Assistant installation.

init.title: CellarTracker options
init.description: Changing the currency relabels the cellar value; it does not convert it. Home Assistant records the value as a long-term statistic in its current unit, so after a change you may need to clear that sensor's statistics before it records again.

data_description.racks: Only for wine racks with LED strips. One rack per line: the CellarTracker location, a colon, then rows x columns, and optionally the bins the rack does not have. For example 'Wine Rack 1: 13x13 without A5-H9' or 'Wine Rack 2: 7x7'. Each rack gets a grid sensor for its LED controller.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the inventory from CellarTracker now, instead of waiting for the next scheduled poll. Repeated calls are rate-limited.

get_wine_by_bin.name: Get wine by bin
get_wine_by_bin.description: Returns the bottles in a rack bin, with their vintage and drinking window, for use in scripts and automations.

bin.name: Bin
bin.description: The bin to look up, as written in CellarTracker. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored.

location.name: Location
location.description: Only look in this location. Leave empty to search every location.

locate_bottle.name: Locate a bottle on its rack
locate_bottle.description: Asks the LED rack the bottle is on to light its bin on its own. The rack's 'paint a wine rack' automation does the lighting.

location.name: Location
location.description: The bottle's CellarTracker location. It must be one of the LED racks in the options.

bin.name: Bin
bin.description: The bin to light, as a row letter and a column, such as A2.

seconds.name: Hold for
seconds.description: How long to keep the bin lit before the overview comes back. 0 keeps it until something else changes the rack.

highlight_bottles.name: Highlight bottles on the racks
highlight_bottles.description: Lights only the bins holding these bottles, in their drinking-window colours, on every LED rack. The overview comes back afterwards.

bottles.name: Bottles
bottles.description: The unique_bottle_id of each bottle to show.

seconds.name: Hold for
seconds.description: How long to keep the highlight before the overview comes back. 0 keeps it until the next sync or overview.

show_overview.name: Show the overview on the racks
show_overview.description: Puts every LED rack back to the full cellar overview, ending a highlight or a located bin.

not_loaded.message: CellarTracker is not set up or has not finished loading yet.

not_on_a_rack.message: There is no LED rack for bin {bin} in {location}. Add the location under the integration's LED racks option.
